sources.finding: UsePrecachingThreadPool defaults to one. Zero dispatches recorded graphics/compute through the alternate file-cache path. Both paths invoke the completion delegate.
Completion saves the device cache, then acquires the global/current cache exclusively and merges. Observed intervals do not isolate driver work from waits.
Early module registration precedes opening the game pipeline cache; engine-loading screen playback follows PreLoadingScreen module loading.
The Slate synchronization thread enqueues render-thread work. Adding a spinner alone cannot establish responsiveness across a blocked render-thread interval.

resource_routing.decision: Reused native source and deterministic runtime validation; prior optional Qwen timeout preserved. No new provider request was necessary.

decision: Retain native default. Alternate scheduler is not accepted as a startup optimization. Do not enable the experimental seed or compatibility setting in production.
next_boundary: Measure a supported preparation/loading path that remains responsive during expensive native work. Existing engine preload screen shares render-thread dependency; source inspection is not runtime responsiveness proof.
